Name: Global Satcoms
Description:
Global Satcoms stands as a prominent global field service engineering firm, specializing in VSAT technologies. Our core competency revolves around catering to VSAT service providers and teleport operators, primarily emphasizing the oil & gas and maritime sectors.

Operating robustly in numerous countries globally, we deliver dependable and effective satellite communication solutions to our esteemed clientele. Our skilled professionals handle everything from installation and maintenance to troubleshooting, ensuring our clients experience seamless connectivity and uninterrupted operations.

Trust Global Satcoms for all your VSAT needs, as we deliver exceptional service wherever you are in the world.

Name: Air Vision Systems
Description:
We design and manufacture cutting-edge mounting solutions for Starlink systems - engineered specifically for marine, campervan, off-road, commercial, residential, and off-grid applications.

Our customers include:
- Yacht and boat owners who need marine-grade Starlink mounts
- 4x4 and overlanding enthusiasts installing Starlink on rugged vehicles
- Caravan, campervan, and motorhome owners wanting seamless internet on the move
- Remote work professionals and adventure travelers who need reliable, stylish Starlink installation solutions
- Commercial sites and construction teams requiring portable internet on remote job sites
- Residential customers seeking discreet, secure mounting for homes or holiday properties

We proudly supply products to large retail chains and have strong partnerships with distributors across New Zealand, Australia, and international markets.

Key strengths:
- Premium, purpose-built Starlink Gen 3 and Starlink Mini mounting solutions
- Marine-grade, corrosion-resistant materials
- Aerodynamic, compact designs for mobile use
- Simple, secure installation
- Designed in New Zealand - tested in real-world harsh environments

If you’re a retailer, distributor, or industry partner looking to bring world-class Starlink mounting solutions to your customers - or a passionate off-grid user seeking the best gear - let’s connect.
